text:
Ashley: Quick sync — onboarding novaX-70b to staging. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/novaX/70b/v1/ (safetensors). Need conversion + TP-shard layout check before we flip serving.
Tomas: Got it. Which dtype do you want us to serve? fp16 or bf16?
Ashley: Prefer bf16 for perf but fallback fp16 if quant issues. One shard uploaded as 0 bytes during put. @Lidya can you check the bucket ACLs?
Lidya: Looking... saw shard-00007.safetensors size 0 in the listing. re-uploading from my node now :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Chris: I started a dry-convert locally to validate layout:
```
./scripts/convert_to_serve.py \  --input s3://redwood-models/novaX/70b/v1/ \  --out /tmp/novaX_conv \  --dtype bf16 \  --tp 4 --shard-by-param
```
Chris: Error on KV cache keys: "unexpected dtype float16 for key 'kv_cache_1'" — looks like one shard got saved in fp16.
Tomas: That explains it. We should run a safetensors scan to assert dtypes across shards. Quick helper:
```py
# check_safetensors_dtype.py
from safetensors import safe_open
import os
for f in os.listdir('.'):
  if f.endswith('.safetensors'):
    with safe_open(f,'r') as s:
      for k,meta in s.metadata.items():
        print(f, k, meta.get('dtype'))
```
Lidya: Re-uploaded shard-00007 now (s3://redwood-models/novaX/70b/v1/shard-00007.safetensors). Verified content md5 matches.
Ashley: Thanks. Can someone also validate tokenizer mapping? Our tokenizer.json seems to have missing <|bos|> token compared to the model vocab.
Chris: Quick test to sample tokens:
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('Hello').tokens)"
```
Chris: On my run, BOS absent; decode(token_id_of_bos) errors.
Tomas: I'll update the serve config to add `special_tokens: {bos_token: '<|bos|>'}` and add a pre-tokenize migration step in the conversion script.
infra-bot: staging-deploy queued: job 89745 — will run after conversion artifacts are pushed.
deploy-bot: smoke tests will run automatically post-deploy :white_check_mark:
Ashley: Plan: Tomas will own conversion (script + dtype scan), Chris will own tokenizer fix, Lidya will re-verify S3 objects and trigger the re-convert. Ping here when converted and artifact URI is ready.
Tomas: ACK, starting conversion now. Expect artifact at s3://redwood-models/novaX/70b/serve-ready/v1/ by EOD.
Lidya: I'll watch the upload and post md5 checksums here.
Chris: I'll add a unit test to the packaging repo to fail CI if any shard dtype mismatches expected. PR incoming.
Ashley: Great — thanks all. @everyone :eyes:
